definitions.explanation: Bags, suitcases, or packages that one carries when traveling. Can also refer to parcels or cargo.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ちましょう→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: You have a lot of luggage.
Where should I put the luggage?

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Please put the luggage in the car. It's big, so be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、{荷物|にもつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧{荷物|にもつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: When I traveled, I had too much luggage and it was tough. Next time I want to go with less luggage.

notes:
{荷物|にもつ} means luggage, baggage, or parcels - items carried when traveling or packages being transported.

COUNTER:
⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ counts pieces of luggage: {荷物|にもつ}⟦{一|いっ}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (one piece of luggage)

TYPES:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧{荷物|にもつ}: hand luggage, carry-on
- ⟦{預|あず}け→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧{荷物|にもつ}: checked baggage
- ⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧{荷物|にもつ}: delivery package

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to check luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive luggage
- {荷物|にもつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put down luggage

TRAVEL IN JAPAN:
Train stations have ⟦コインロッカー→コインロッカー：30576_koinrokkaa⟧ (coin lockers) for storing {荷物|にもつ}. Luggage delivery services (⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧) can send bags ahead to your next hotel.
